phase.name: Multi-Asset Artworks
phase.goal: Allow grouping multiple assets into a single logical artwork with shared metadata, enabling curators to manage composite works (e.g. diptychs, triptychs, or multi-part installations) as one entity.

in.item: Grouping multiple ArtworkInstances into a single Artwork (multi-asset works)
Shared metadata (title, artist, description) across grouped instances
Multi-selection of placed instances in the editor
"Group into Artwork" action that links selected instances under one Artwork record
Ungroup action to separate instances back into individual artworks
Visual indicator for grouped instances (e.g. shared outline color or group label)
Info overlay in viewer showing combined metadata for grouped artworks

out.item: Movable walls (now covered by the separate Feature-ModularWalls specification)
Automatic layout or alignment of grouped instances

frontend.item: Implement multi-selection of ArtworkInstances (e.g. Shift+Click or drag-box selection).
Add a "Group into Artwork" context menu action that creates or updates a shared Artwork record.
Display a shared outline or indicator for all instances belonging to the same Artwork group.
In the PropertiesPanel, show shared metadata fields when a grouped instance is selected.
Add an "Ungroup" action to detach instances from a shared Artwork.

backend.item: Support multiple Assets per Artwork and proper linkage from ArtworkInstance to Asset and Artwork.
Add API endpoint or extend existing ones to group/ungroup instances under a shared Artwork.
Ensure version snapshots preserve group relationships.

successCriteria.item: Curators can select two or more placed image instances and group them into one artwork with shared title and description.
Grouped instances display a visual indicator showing they belong together.
Editing metadata on one grouped instance updates all instances in the group.
Curators can ungroup instances back into independent artworks.
